reviews.issue: Claims the product can be sliced thinly, but it is minced beef.
States the milk is unsweetened while the product is sweetened.
Says the floor cleaner has no scent, contradicting the labeled fragrance.
Describes a 1 L volume for a product that is 500 ml.
Claims the sanitary pad is at least 35 cm long, but the label says 30 cm.
Confuses mass (630 g) with volume (630 ml) for the shampoo.
Asserts the floor cleaner is safe for cats without such a label claim.
Makes a therapeutic claim that the face wash treats acne in two weeks.
States the body wash is non‑irritating for sensitive skin without label support.
Specifies an unrealistically short 30‑second heating time for bao.
Suggests slicing ground pork, which contradicts its minced form.
